description: Business rules of the Topia -> Equus EAFH transformation. A rule changes import output only while approved_for_import is true; a Jake answer is evidence, not approval (every tracker Status in clarifications/jake-1.xlsx column I is Open). Validated strictly by mapping_config.load_business_rules().

dependent_source.owner: Alka / Topia (keyed dependent extract, D3); Jake (Equus layout)
dependent_source.notes: Q11/Q18/Q19 (Jake): dependents go in the same import, linked to their assignment by the Assignment Identifier. The Topia 'Dependent Import' sheet has no Employee/Assignment key (assessment D3), so no keyed sheet is configured (sheet null) and any dependent sheet without key columns is reported HELD_DEPENDENTS_UNKEYED. Set sheet, the row numbers and the key column labels once Topia delivers a keyed extract, then approved_for_import after review. The join is by Assignment ID only, never by Employee Number.

identity_controls.notes: UAT-03 (BR-01, BR-05, BR-17, BR-18). Validation and holding only: these controls never change a value, they keep rows out of the import workbook and report them. No fallback from a missing Assignment Identifier to the Employee Number (BR-01). TEMPLATE_VERSION EAFH-bundled-1 = the template bundled at lambda/src/templates/equus_eafh_template.xlsx (SHA-256 below); Equus has not supplied an official template version number (D2 / Q5, owner Jake). D1 (which Topia column is 'Topia ID') is still open; column X 'Assignment ID' stays the identifier per the assessment until Jake / Alka decide.

MISSING_ASSIGNMENT_ID.description: No Assignment Identifier in the source row; never replaced by the Employee Number (BR-01).

MISSING_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER.description: No Employee Number (Talent Link ID); the assignment cannot be linked to an employee (Q1, Q17).

DUPLICATE_ROW.description: Every compared source cell equals an earlier row; the earlier row is accepted, this one is held (Q5: duplicates can create duplicates in Equus).

CONFLICTING_IDENTIFIER.description: The same Assignment Identifier appears on rows with different data; every such row is held.

ALREADY_ACCEPTED.description: Identifier was accepted by an earlier run listed as previously accepted; not imported again (docs/uat/REPROCESSING_PROCEDURE.md).

HEADER_MISMATCH.description: Output header rows differ from the approved template; Q5: header issues fail the whole import, so the import workbook is withheld.

TEMPLATE_HASH_DIFFERS.description: Supplied template headers match, but its SHA-256 differs from the approved template version.

HEADER_DECISION_PENDING.description: Header cell differs between the approved template and Jake's example; header kept as in the approved template until Jake decides.

ROW_STRUCTURE_INVALID.description: Generated rows do not follow the INSERT / UPDATE pattern of Jake's example sheet ' Mny dependents Ex'.

VALIDATION_WARNING.description: Value-level validation warning; the value is kept (see Warnings sheet).
